rationale: Ink & Signal light theme takes its own status.success token (#2BA85E) instead of the dark theme's ink.leaf-bright, which read at about 1.5:1 as text on a white card; dark is unchanged. The Badge and InlineBanner component goldens are re-baked to the intended renders (drawn tone marks plus the per-theme success ink). This changes one native theme colour value and four reference PNGs; no design-import, Chromium, rendering backend, or packaging authority moves.
